method: One fresh agent per request and skill version, with minimal task context, isolated outputs, installed public declarations, and no live writes. Baseline used the pre-change skill snapshot. Reviewed generated code, not just agent summaries. Single runs do not establish statistical improvement.

comparisons.both: Strict TypeScript passed. Next 16.3.8 webpack production builds passed. Chromium 151 at 390px with reduced motion emulated passed native legend Enter/Space toggles, complete tables, zero/missing observations, and pending/empty/error transitions; no page errors observed.
comparisons.revised: Uses chart-native loading props while keeping charts mounted; disables legend changes during pending and retains page-controlled visibility.
comparisons.baseline: Uses host loading text and unmounts charts while pending; still satisfies the requested states and data alternatives.
comparisons.assessment: Both produced functional dashboards; native loading guidance was adopted only in the revised run. Do not claim baseline failure.

comparisons.both: Bundler typechecks and public-model checks passed. Preserved custom revenue gradient, forecast tooltip using entry.payload, gradient Sankey links with Glow finish, stable flow IDs, and Heatmap zero/missing values with complete data alternatives.
comparisons.revised: Omits Default material props and explicitly explains custom paint ownership; chooses stable raw row IDs for revenue categories. Strict NodeNext and Bundler both passed without skipLibCheck.
comparisons.baseline: Sets explicit Default appearance props and supplies an extra consumer-owned projection overlay. Uses stable row keys and flow endpoints, but month display labels as the bar category axis. A later strict NodeNext run failed TS2835: entry.tsx imported ./Consumer without an ESM extension; baseline output was left unchanged.
comparisons.assessment: Both preserve the requested encodings. The revised result follows Default omission and separates stable category identity from display labels; only the revised family output passed NodeNext unchanged. Family-panel browser checks remain unrun.

trigger_probe.method: Separate fresh agent received only skill metadata and four requests, with no expected answers.
trigger_probe.outcome: Invoked for Kind UI matrix and migration requests; declined Recharts-only and release-workflow requests. Four decisions matched intended scope.

bundled_examples: All four full examples and scaffolded good rule snippets compile strict NodeNext and Bundler without skipLibCheck against released 0.3.0. Four frontmatter/link/scope contract tests pass.
discovery: Official skills CLI 1.7.1 selected only kind-ui-charts from the local repository in an isolated project; copied skill contents matched byte-for-byte. No personal/global installation.
independent_review: Independent reviewer found tooltip unit formatting and configured-Line callback ownership issues. Both fixed and rechecked; no remaining skill blockers.
limits: One run per task/version; no timing/token benchmark or statistical claim.
Reduced motion was emulated and screenshots inspected; no exhaustive animation or assistive-technology audit.
Official docs retrieval returned HTTP 403 in family runs; installed npm declarations supplied the contracts.
Repository-wide gate outcome is recorded separately in the PR; these consumer evaluations do not substitute for it.
